I'm implementing SkillsMultiSelect using Popover, Command, and CommandItem components from shadcn/ui. </details></think>

_**Agent (composer-2-fast)**_


No tengo memoria de conversaciones anteriores; solo lo que aparece en el repo y en el historial de SpecStory.

**Lo que sí consta en el historial del proyecto**

1. **`SkillsMultiSelect` no es un “copy-paste” de una URL guardada.** En la sesión del 11-dic-2025 ([`.specstory/history/2025-12-11_10-43Z-fix-multi-select-combobox-component-issues.md`](file:///home/gonzalo/gonzalopozo.github.io/.specstory/history/2025-12-11_10-43Z-fix-multi-select-combobox-component-issues.md)) se creó `skills-multi-select.tsx` como componente cliente nuevo que usa **`Popover` + `Command` + `CommandInput` + `CommandItem`** de tus piezas en `components/ui/` — es el patrón típico del **Combobox de shadcn/ui** (basado en **cmdk** y **Radix Popover**).

2. **Antes** habías dicho que habías **copiado** `components/multi-select.tsx` para tener un multi-select tipo combobox; en ese hilo **no aparece** de qué web concreta lo sacaste (solo que lo copiaste tú a ese archivo).

**Resumen:** El origen “web” del **`multi-select.tsx` original no quedó documentado** en lo que hay en el repositorio. El **`SkillsMultiSelect` actual** encaja con la documentación de **shadcn/ui (Combobox con Popover + Command)** y los primitivos que ya tenías instalados. Si recuerdas si el multi-select venía de un gist, de la doc de shadcn, de otro blog, etc., puedes anotarlo en un comentario al inicio de `skills-multi-select.tsx` para no perderlo otra vez.

- Un **error de compilación** que cita `./components/multi-select.tsx` (líneas ~146–149 del hilo).
- El **diff de la página** que quita `MultiSelectCombobox` y muestra **una línea** de uso con `renderItem`, `renderSelectedItem`, `options`, `value`, `onChange` (aprox. líneas 419–477).
- Al final, un **ejemplo mínimo** en el resumen del agente con las props de `MultiSelectCombobox` (líneas ~931–936).

Eso **no sustituye** al archivo entero: no hay el cuerpo de `MultiSelectCombobox` ni el resto de `multi-select.tsx`. El código **sí** quedó bien documentado en el mismo hilo es el de **`skills-multi-select.tsx`** (el diff completo a partir de ~línea 215).

Si `multi-select.tsx` ya no está en el repo (parece que se eliminó), recuperarlo solo desde SpecStory **no es posible** con lo que hay exportado ahí.

```
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, ChevronsUpDown, ListFilter, X } from "lucide-react";
import {
    Command,
    CommandEmpty,
    CommandGroup,
    CommandInput,
    CommandItem,
    CommandList,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import {
    Popover,
    PopoverContent,
    PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Skill {
    id: number;
    name: string;
}

interface SkillsMultiSelectProps {
    skills: Skill[];
    /** Name attribute for form submission */
    name?: string;
    /** Initial selected skill IDs */
    defaultValue?: number[];
    /** Placeholder text */
    placeholder?: string;
}

export function SkillsMultiSelect({
    skills,
    name = "skills",
    defaultValue = [],
    placeholder = "Search skills...",
}: SkillsMultiSelectProps) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState&lt;number[]&gt;(defaultValue);

    const handleSelect = (skillId: number) =&gt; {
        setSelectedIds((current) =&gt;
            current.includes(skillId)
                ? current.filter((id) =&gt; id !== skillId)
                : [...current, skillId]
        );
    };

    const handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent) =&gt; {
        e.stopPropagation();
        setSelectedIds([]);
    };

    const selectedSkills = skills.filter((skill) =&gt; selectedIds.includes(skill.id));

    return (
        &lt;&gt;
            {/* Hidden inputs for form submission */}
            {selectedIds.map((id) =&gt; (
                &lt;input key={id} type="hidden" name={name} value={id} /&gt;
            ))}

            &lt;Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}&gt;
                &lt;PopoverTrigger asChild&gt;
                    &lt;div
                        role="combobox"
                        aria-expanded={open}
                        aria-haspopup="listbox"
                        aria-controls="skills-select-options"
                        aria-label="Select skills"
                        tabIndex={0}
                        className="flex h-10 min-w-[200px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2"
                        onClick={() =&gt; setOpen(!open)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) =&gt; {
                            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                setOpen(!open);
                            }
                        }}
                    &gt;
                        &lt;ListFilter
                            className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        /&gt;
                        
                        {selectedIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
                            &lt;span className="text-muted-foreground"&gt;Skills&lt;/span&gt;
                        )}

                        &lt;div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden"&gt;
                            {selectedSkills.length &gt; 0 ? (
                                &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1"&gt;
                                    {selectedSkills.slice(0, 3).map((skill) =&gt; (
                                        &lt;span
                                            key={skill.id}
                                            className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-primary"
                                        &gt;
                                            {skill.name}
                                        &lt;/span&gt;
                                    ))}
                                    {selectedSkills.length &gt; 3 &amp;&amp; (
                                        &lt;span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground"&gt;
                                            +{selectedSkills.length - 3} more
                                        &lt;/span&gt;
                                    )}
                                &lt;/div&gt;
                            ) : (
                                &lt;span className="text-muted-foreground"&gt;Select skills...&lt;/span&gt;
                            )}
                        &lt;/div&gt;

                        &lt;span className="z-10 ml-auto flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
                            {selectedIds.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
                                &lt;button
                                    type="button"
                                    aria-label="Clear selection"
                                    className="z-10 rounded-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring"
                                    onClick={handleClear}
                                &gt;
                                    &lt;X className="size-4 shrink-0" /&gt;
                                &lt;/button&gt;
                            )}
                            &lt;ChevronsUpDown
                                className="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-50"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            /&gt;
                        &lt;/span&gt;
                    &lt;/div&gt;
                &lt;/PopoverTrigger&gt;

                &lt;PopoverContent
                    className="w-[--radix-popover-trigger-width] p-0"
                    id="skills-select-options"
                &gt;
                    &lt;Command&gt;
                        &lt;CommandInput placeholder={placeholder} aria-label="Search skills" /&gt;
                        &lt;CommandList&gt;
                            &lt;CommandEmpty&gt;No skills found.&lt;/CommandEmpty&gt;
                            &lt;CommandGroup&gt;
                                {skills.map((skill) =&gt; (
                                    &lt;CommandItem
                                        key={skill.id}
                                        value={skill.name}
                                        onSelect={() =&gt; handleSelect(skill.id)}
                                        aria-selected={selectedIds.includes(skill.id)}
                                    &gt;
                                        &lt;Check
                                            className={cn(
                                                "mr-2 h-4 w-4",
                                                selectedIds.includes(skill.id)
                                                    ? "opacity-100"
                                                    : "opacity-0"
                                            )}
                                            aria-hidden="true"
                                        /&gt;
                                        {skill.name}
                                    &lt;/CommandItem&gt;
                                ))}
                            &lt;/CommandGroup&gt;
                        &lt;/CommandList&gt;
                    &lt;/Command&gt;
                &lt;/PopoverContent&gt;
            &lt;/Popover&gt;
        &lt;/&gt;
    );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { Check, ChevronsUpDown, ListFilter, X } from "lucide-react";
import {
    Command,
    CommandEmpty,
    CommandGroup,
    CommandInput,
    CommandItem,
    CommandList,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import {
    Popover,
    PopoverContent,
    PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface Skill {
    id: number;
    name: string;
}

interface SkillsMultiSelectProps {
    skills: Skill[];
    /** Name attribute for form submission */
    name?: string;
    /** Initial selected skill IDs */
    defaultValue?: number[];
    /** Placeholder text */
    placeholder?: string;
}

export function SkillsMultiSelect({
    skills,
    name = "skills",
    defaultValue = [],
    placeholder = "Search skills...",
}: SkillsMultiSelectProps) {
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<number[]>(defaultValue);

    const handleSelect = (skillId: number) => {
        setSelectedIds((current) =>
            current.includes(skillId)
                ? current.filter((id) => id !== skillId)
                : [...current, skillId]
        );
    };

    const handleClear = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        setSelectedIds([]);
    };

    const selectedSkills = skills.filter((skill) => selectedIds.includes(skill.id));

    return (
        <>
            {/* Hidden inputs for form submission */}
            {selectedIds.map((id) => (
                <input key={id} type="hidden" name={name} value={id} />
            ))}

            <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
                <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                    <div
                        role="combobox"
                        aria-expanded={open}
                        aria-haspopup="listbox"
                        aria-controls="skills-select-options"
                        aria-label="Select skills"
                        tabIndex={0}
                        className="flex h-10 min-w-[200px] cursor-pointer items-center justify-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2"
                        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
                        onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                setOpen(!open);
                            }
                        }}
                    >
                        <ListFilter
                            className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"
                            aria-hidden="true"
                        />
                        
                        {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">Skills</span>
                        )}

                        <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-1 overflow-hidden">
                            {selectedSkills.length > 0 ? (
                                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                                    {selectedSkills.slice(0, 3).map((skill) => (
                                        <span
                                            key={skill.id}
                                            className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-primary"
                                        >
                                            {skill.name}
                                        </span>
                                    ))}
                                    {selectedSkills.length > 3 && (
                                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                            +{selectedSkills.length - 3} more
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            ) : (
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Select skills...</span>
                            )}
                        </div>

                        <span className="z-10 ml-auto flex items-center gap-2">
                            {selectedIds.length > 0 && (
                                <button
                                    type="button"
                                    aria-label="Clear selection"
                                    className="z-10 rounded-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring"
                                    onClick={handleClear}
                                >
                                    <X className="size-4 shrink-0" />
                                </button>
                            )}
                            <ChevronsUpDown
                                className="size-4 shrink-0 opacity-50"
                                aria-hidden="true"
                            />
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </PopoverTrigger>

                <PopoverContent
                    className="w-[--radix-popover-trigger-width] p-0"
                    id="skills-select-options"
                >
                    <Command>
                        <CommandInput placeholder={placeholder} aria-label="Search skills" />
                        <CommandList>
                            <CommandEmpty>No skills found.</CommandEmpty>
                            <CommandGroup>
                                {skills.map((skill) => (
                                    <CommandItem
                                        key={skill.id}
                                        value={skill.name}
                                        onSelect={() => handleSelect(skill.id)}
                                        aria-selected={selectedIds.includes(skill.id)}
                                    >
                                        <Check
                                            className={cn(
                                                "mr-2 h-4 w-4",
                                                selectedIds.includes(skill.id)
                                                    ? "opacity-100"
                                                    : "opacity-0"
                                            )}
                                            aria-hidden="true"
                                        />
                                        {skill.name}
                                    </CommandItem>
                                ))}
                            </CommandGroup>
                        </CommandList>
                    </Command>
                </PopoverContent>
            </Popover>
        </>
    );
}
```
